name: Vartika
reason: vartikā is attested Sanskrit (lamp wick; also a quail); auspicious light imagery, IAST and Devanagari agree

name: Lalima
reason: lālimā, redness/ruddy glow, standard Sanskrit-derived abstract noun; scripts agree

name: Vanshika
reason: vaṃśikā from vaṃśa (flute/lineage) with -ikā; sound and agreeing scripts

name: Wamika
reason: W spelling is non-standard for v; vāmā (beautiful woman, a name of Durga/Lakshmi) with diminutive -ikā is acceptable but less firmly attested

fix.name: Vamika
fix.meaning_en: Little beautiful one (from vāmā, 'beautiful woman', a name of Durga)

name: Anvi
reason: No attested Sanskrit anvī or Lakshmi epithet; claim unsupported; kept as modern name with honest meaning

fix.name: Anvi
fix.meaning_en: etymology uncertain; modern name, popularly glossed 'graceful'

name: Hiya
reason: hṛdayā is not a real feminine form (hṛdaya is neuter); Hiya is the Hindi/Bengali hiyā derived from Sanskrit hṛdaya via Prakrit

name: Tvisha
reason: tviṣ/tviṣā radiance, Vedic word; scripts agree

name: Vritika
reason: common_noun_or_technical_term: vṛttikā is a commentary/livelihood term, not an auspicious personal name; meaning weak

name: Saloni
reason: Hindi salonī/salonā (charming), from Sanskrit lāvaṇya, not Sanskrit; IAST salonī and सलोनी agree but gloss must state vernacular origin

fix.name: Saloni
fix.meaning_en: Charming, graceful (Hindi salonī, ultimately from Sanskrit lāvaṇya, 'charm')

name: Priyal
reason: other: IAST priyala/प्रियल does not match name; priyāla is a tree name; no sound Sanskrit derivation (modern coinage from priya)
